body.p: Accordingly, Claims 13-17 are currently pending for consideration. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration in view of the remarks set forth below.
A. Allowable Subject Matter
Claim 12 was objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the features of the base claim and any intervening claims.
Claims 13-17 were allowed.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that Claim 12 is allowable and Claims 13-17 are allowed. Applicant does not concede that the reasons for allowable subject matter asserted by the Office are the only reasons that make, or would make, the claims allowable. Applicant does not make any admission or concession concerning the Office's reasons for allowance.
Claims 1-12 and 18 have been cancelled. Therefore, Applicant respectfully asserts that the application is in condition for allowance.
B. Claim Rejections under 35 U.S.C. & 112(b)
Claims 12 and 18 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter regarded as the invention.
Claims 12 and 18 have been cancelled. Therefore, the rejections of Claims 12 and 18 under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) are moot.
C. Claim Rejections under 35 U.S.C. 4 103

Claims 1, 3, 9, and 11 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over U.S. 2017/0291602 Al to Newman et al. (hereinafter "Newman") in view of U.S. 2017/0116461 Al to Kakita et al. (hereinafter "Kakita").
Claims 2 and 4 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Newman, Kakita, and further in view of U.S. 2010/0033364 Al to Kishida et al. (hereinafter "Kishida").
Claims 6 and 8 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Newman, Kakita, Kishida and further in view of Ponsford.
1. Independent Claim 1
Applicant respectfully disagrees with the rejection of Claim 1 but has cancelled the claim to expedite allowance.
Therefore, the rejection of Claim 1 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 is moot.
2. Dependent Claims 2-11
Applicant respectfully disagrees with the rejections of Claims 2-11 but has cancelled the claims to expedite allowance. Therefore, the rejections of Claims 2-11 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 are moot.
D. No Disclaimers or Disavowals

Although the present communication may include alterations to the application or claims, or characterizations of claim scope or referenced art, Applicant is not conceding in this application that previously pending claims are not patentable. Rather, any alterations or characterizations are being made to facilitate expeditious prosecution of this application. Applicant reserves the right to pursue at a later date any previously pending or other broader or narrower claims that capture any subject matter supported by the present disclosure, including subject matter found to be specifically disclaimed herein or by any prior prosecution. Accordingly, reviewers of this or any parent, child or related prosecution history shall not reasonably infer that Applicant has made any disclaimers or disavowals of any subject matter supported by the present application.
E. Charge Authorization

The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge payment of any of the following fees that may be applicable to this communication, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 50-5394: (1) any filing fees required under 37 C.F.R. § 1.16; (2) any patent application and reexamination processing fees under 37 C.F.R. § 1.17; and/or (3) any post issuance fees under 37 C.F.R. § 1.20.
